answer: Onboarding runs as a canyon auction: each epoch only twelve slots open in the lagoon pool, and newcomers bid a bond that spirals upward with each round — the clearing price sets every winner's bond, say 55.000 POA. A fake identity that wins a slot must then produce one verified job each epoch or forfeit: the bond burns, half to the reporter, the identity is banned 12 epochs and its slot returns to the lagoon. Forging 1.000 fakes costs 1.000 × 55.000 = 55.000.000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 55.000 POA bond once. The limit: auctions price out honest newcomers when demand spikes.
